records.title: Reuters: Tether and Circle freeze $2.38B after Binance reports potential security issue
records.note: Reuters reports Binance was investigating a potential security issue and said user funds were safe; Tether said it froze nearly $1.57B, Circle over $800M, and Binance co-founder Yi He said Ripple had frozen roughly $200M. Reuters does not identify the asset, chain or addresses for Ripple's reported freeze. Binance had not confirmed theft.

records.title: AP: Binance investigates potential security issue as stablecoin issuers freeze funds
records.note: AP independently reports the extent of damage was unclear and Binance had not explicitly confirmed funds were pilfered; Binance said user funds were safe. AP quotes Circle CEO as saying more than $800M USDC-equivalent was frozen in coordination with law enforcement and Tether CEO as saying more than $1.5B was frozen.

records.title: XRPL documentation: freezing issued tokens
records.note: XRPL docs explicitly state no one can freeze native XRP on the XRP Ledger; issuers can freeze issued trust-line tokens, while custodial exchanges can freeze assets they custody. This is the protocol-level disconfirming evidence against interpreting an unspecified Ripple freeze as native XRP frozen at ledger level.

records.title: Privy: Building payments and agentic commerce with the XRP Ledger
records.note: Privy's official announcement describes a Stripe-owned wallet-infrastructure partnership with Ripple/XRPL to support programmable wallets and agentic commerce. Announcement establishes integration intent/capability, not production volume, XRP inventory demand or material settlement flow.

records.title: TradRadar XRP derivatives snapshot, October 29 19:05 UTC
records.note: Pre-Binance-incident snapshot: XRP $1.2831, aggregate OI about $2.00B across seven venues, OI down 0.11%, funding +0.0071% per eight hours, at least $5.72M liquidations mostly longs, 79.2% long-account share across five venues. Secondary dashboard; account ratio is not notional exposure; venue scope and aggregation not independently reconciled.

records.title: CoinMarketCap XRP live market page
records.note: Dynamic page at capture displayed approximately $1.29, +2.01% over 24 hours, $82.22B market cap, $2.13B 24h volume and 63.35B circulating supply. No synchronized exchange quote timestamp was exposed; not comparable with other aggregator pages or admitted as a feature.

records.title: CoinDesk XRP live market page
records.note: Dynamic page at capture displayed $81.72B market cap, $1.10B 24h volume and a 2.77% decline. Quote timestamp and venue universe were not aligned with CoinMarketCap or Coinbase; retained as a conflicting aggregator observation, not averaged or admitted.

records.title: Coinbase XRP market page
records.note: Dynamic page displayed approximately $81.762B market cap and $2.141B 24h volume, and stated 98% of Coinbase customers increased their net XRP position through trading over the prior 24 hours. This is a platform-specific user-count share, not dollar-weighted flow, not all Coinbase volume, and not representative of the whole market.

records.title: Permission official ASK token documentation
records.note: Permission describes ASK as its native token for consent/rewards and agent-to-agent coordination, fixed 100B supply, LayerZero OFT, and active Base and Polygon contracts. No XRPL deployment or direct XRP integration is listed in this documentation.

records.title: CoinMarketCap Permission Coin (ASK)
records.note: Dynamic page displayed roughly $0.00008727, $1.41M market cap, $235.51 24h volume, 16.16B circulating and 100B maximum supply. Extremely thin reported turnover; figures are dynamic and should be independently checked on Base/Polygon explorers and venue order books.

records.title: CoinMarketCap GoAsk (ASK) separate ticker candidate
records.note: A separate GoAsk asset also uses ticker ASK, with a 1B supply and a different Ethereum contract. This establishes ticker ambiguity; it is not the Permission Coin ASK token.

records.title: Times Tabloid: Zach Rector's XRP market-cap multiplier analysis
records.note: Reports a roughly 1,200x ratio of market-cap change to reported exchange netflows during a volatile interval and explicitly notes exchange transfers do not measure actual capital entering or leaving the market. Its suggestion that CVD better measures buy/sell pressure is a useful but incomplete proxy: CVD is executed order-flow imbalance, not total new capital or OTC/ETF funding.

records.title: CoinTurk: XRP market-cap change versus reported exchange netflows
records.note: Reports a 986x ratio derived from a $43.74B market-cap increase divided by about $44.3M in exchange netflows. This arithmetic does not demonstrate a capital multiplier: exchange netflows are transfers, not executed purchases or fiat/stablecoin inflows; market cap is marginal price multiplied by supply.

records.title: YouTube channel listing: Kamilah Stevenson | XRP & Stocks
records.note: YouTube search index identifies channel ID UCXm6KAr1WHF6UN7g5b2W7wg and handle @KamilahStevensonXrpStocks. Channel description covers stocks, crypto, market insights and long-term investing. It does not identify the creator as the exact requested spelling Camilla Stephenson.

records.title: The XRP Podcast: Crypto Panics with Dr. Kamilah Stevenson
records.note: Transcript includes the guest identifying herself as Camilla Stevenson on X and Dr Camilla Stevenson on YouTube, while the episode title and other indexed channel materials use Kamilah. She warns that fake pages exist. This supports spelling/branding variants and impersonation risk, but does not prove equivalence to the exact requested name Camilla Stephenson.
